Wait while phone is released second; remember doll then phone.

Wait for fourth selection; remembered sequence is doll, phone, camera.

Wait for final watch placement and demonstrator return. Remember doll, phone, camera, vehicle, watch.
Wait motionless for the fifth object, watch. Sequence retained: doll, phone, camera, vehicle, watch.
Continue waiting, with no policy movement. Watch remains the final demonstration object.
Observe watch pickup fifth without moving either policy arm.
Watch is carried fifth. Continue waiting for release and complete demonstrator return; order doll, phone, camera, vehicle, watch.
Hold still until final watch release and demonstrator return. Remember doll, phone, camera, gold vehicle, watch.
All five demonstration objects appear in basket; remain still until opposite arm returns completely. Order: doll, phone, camera, vehicle, watch.
Wait for opposite arm to finish returning. Retain order: doll, phone, camera, gold vehicle, watch.
Final stationary check that opposite arm has finished at home before beginning imitation: doll, phone, camera, vehicle, watch.
Demonstrator is stationary at home. Begin first object, doll: lift and approach with left arm, smoothly tilting downward; keep right arm parked.
Align left gripper over the doll near the workspace center, rotating gradually to a downward grasp. Right arm remains parked.
Lower slightly around the doll, close fully, and perform a short test lift. Verify retention visually before transferring.
Small upward and leftward test with gripper closed to check whether doll follows; current retention is uncertain.
Doll stayed on the table during test. Reopen and realign farther forward over its body, lowering cautiously for another grasp.
Descend around the doll body, close fully, then lift gently to verify retention before first placement.
Doll follows the gripper in RGB. Keep fully closed, lift clear of the table and carry it left toward the policy basket as the first object.
Lower the retained doll into the policy basket, open to release the first object, then withdraw vertically. Next object is the phone.
Doll is released in the policy basket. Begin second object, phone, approaching with the right arm while left stays clear over its own workspace.
Finish aligning the open right gripper vertically over the phone. Maintain elbow-up continuity and leave the other objects untouched.
Lower around the phone, close fully and test-lift it. Phone must be second; basket transfer will follow only after visual retention check.
Phone is retained. Lift and move it to a central staging area, keeping right EE on its own side; left arm will place it into the left basket without crossing arms.
Set the phone down near the midline for left-arm pickup, then open and withdraw the right gripper. Keep both EEs on their own sides.
Phone rests near the midline. Clear the right arm to its own workspace while bringing the open left gripper above the phone for second placement.
Align and lower the left gripper over the staged phone, staying on the left side of the midline; right arm stays clear.
Close on the staged phone and lift with the left arm. Verify that it follows before carrying it into the basket as object two.
Phone follows the left gripper. Carry it above the back half of the policy basket, clear of the first doll, keeping the grasp closed.
Replan after the rejected final transit step: lower the phone into the basket with smaller increments, release second, and withdraw gently.
Phone is released inside the basket after the doll. Move the open left gripper above the black camera for the third placement.
Descend over the camera, close fully and begin a small test lift for the third object. Keep the other arm stationary.
Camera appears between the fingers. Lift clear and carry it toward the front of the policy basket as the third object, keeping the gripper closed.
Camera is retained above the basket. Lower it slightly inward, open to release third, and lift clear. Gold vehicle is next.
Camera is released third in the basket. Approach the gold vehicle with the right gripper for fourth placement; keep left arm clear.
Descend around the gold vehicle, close fully and lift briefly to check retention before staging it for the fourth basket placement.
Vehicle retention is uncertain. Make a small closed-gripper lift and lateral test before attempting transfer.
Vehicle stayed on the table. Reopen, center over its shifted body, and approach lower for a secure fourth-object grasp.
Close around the lower vehicle body, pause for the grasp, then lift vertically to verify retention.
Vehicle is retained in RGB. Carry it to the central staging area with right EE remaining on its own side, for left-arm placement fourth.
Set the retained vehicle down at the midline, with a slight inward tilt for accessible left-side pickup. Open and withdraw; keep the left arm clear.
Vehicle rests at the midline. Clear the right arm away first while approaching from the left, both grippers open and arms on their own sides.
Align the open left gripper over the staged vehicle and descend cautiously. Right arm remains clear; vehicle is the fourth target.
Lower a little farther around the vehicle body, close the left gripper fully and lift to confirm retention before fourth placement.
Vehicle follows the left gripper. Carry it above the policy basket as the fourth object, keeping it closed and clearing the placed objects.
Lower the retained vehicle into the basket beside the doll, release fourth, and withdraw. The green watch is the final target.
Vehicle is released fourth. Approach the final green watch with the right gripper, restoring a vertical grasp while the left arm stays clear.
Lower the right fingers around the watch, close fully, then test-lift the final object. Maintain the demonstrated sequence.
Watch is retained. Lift and carry it to the midline staging area with right EE on its own side, for left-arm placement of the fifth object.
Set the final watch down at the midline for left-arm pickup, open the right gripper and withdraw vertically without crossing arms.
Watch is staged on the table. Withdraw the right arm into its workspace while approaching with the open left gripper, avoiding arm crossing.
Align the open left gripper around the staged watch and descend. Keep the right arm clear; watch is the fifth and final target.
Fine-align and lower the left fingers around the watch, close fully, and test-lift the final object while staying on the left side.
Watch did not rise with the last attempt. Reopen and grasp lower around its band, then test-lift again before any basket motion.
Watch band now appears between the fingers. Test retention with a short upward-left motion, keeping fully closed and watching whether it follows.
Watch remained on the table. Reopen and approach slightly nearer the robot, centered lower over the band rather than its far edge.
Adjust a few millimeters toward the watch center, grasp below the band top, and lift slowly to verify retention.
Watch now appears pinched between the fingers. Lift and shift left with the gripper fully closed to verify it follows before the final basket transfer.
Watch follows the gripper. Carry it above the near-right interior of the policy basket as the fifth object, keeping the grasp closed.
Lower the retained watch slightly inward into the basket, release it fifth, and withdraw vertically with both grippers open.
All five policy objects appear in the basket in demonstrated order. Begin a gradual, elbow-up return of both open grippers toward origin, clearing the baskets.
Continue the smooth return to both original EE poses with grippers open, leaving all five objects undisturbed in each basket.
